data.additional_information:
Ayaan is hiring Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineers to build the autonomy stack that powers our UAVs, UGVs, USVs, UUVs, and ground robotic platforms. The role spans perception, state estimation, localization, mapping (SLAM), planning, navigation, and control — implemented on ROS 2 with NVIDIA Jetson / Orin compute, Gazebo / Isaac Sim simulation, and PX4 / ArduPilot flight stacks. PhD candidates will be considered for senior roles owning a SLAM, planning, or autonomy-architecture workstream.

Job Responsibilities
1.Contribute to the architecture of Ayaan's autonomy stack — perception, state estimation, planning, control, and mission management — across UAV, UGV, USV, and UUV platforms. 
2.Implement and tune visual guided autonomous vehicles. Build robust localization in GNSS-denied indoor, urban canyon, underwater, and forested environments. 
3.Develop motion planners (RRT*, A*, MPC-based, MPPI, CBF), multi-vehicle coordination, and behavior of trees / state machines for mission execution. 
4.Implement and tune low-level controllers for multirotor, fixed-wing UAVs, ground vehicles, and marine platforms — PID, cascaded loops, MPC, and adaptive control. 5.Integrate with PX4 / ArduPilot or proprietary autopilots. 
6.Build high-fidelity simulation environments in Gazebo, Isaac Sim, AirSim, or proprietary simulators. Use them for SITL/HITL testing and continuous integration of the autonomy stack. 
7.Deploy autonomy stacks on linux/yocto based OS on edge devices such as qualcomm, NVIDIA Jetson Orin / Xavier, Raspberry Pi, and custom onboard computer. 8.Integrate with cameras, LiDARs, sonars, IMUs, GNSS, and mission payloads. 7
9.Take autonomy out of the lab — flight tests, ground trials, marine operations. Debug edge cases and continuously improve robustness, reliability, and operational envelopes.

Skills Required-
1. Strong fundamentals in robotics, state estimation, control systems, and probabilistic methods. 
2. Proficiency in C++ and Python; comfortable with modern C++ (14/17/20) for real-time robotics code. 
3. Hands-on experience with ROS / ROS 2 — packages, launch, lifecycle nodes, DDS, and real-time considerations. 
4. Working experience with at least one SLAM stack (ORB-SLAM, VINS, LIO-SAM, Cartographer) and one planning / control stack. 
5. Comfortable on NVIDIA Jetson and embedded Linux platforms; familiarity with CUDA / TensorRT is a strong plus.
6. Familiarity with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, AirSim) and with PX4 / ArduPilot internals.
7. Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills across hardware, firmware, and high-level autonomy.

Educational Qualification- PhD/ M.Tech / M.Tech (Research)
Minimum Experience-0-2 years
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
